_metadata.description: Authentic screen presentation. First-release contract; completion follows requirement-linked behavior and retained protocol evidence.

requirements.title: The compositor shall preserve explicit fit and crop.
requirements.description: The compositor shall preserve capture aspect and identity in contain or explicitly selected crop mode, expose the lost region and verify required readable content at final projected size.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-SCREEN-FIT protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.
Partial evidence only. Specific tagged test case(s): TestComposeContainsSourceWithoutStretchOrCrop. This does not establish the full requirement.
Partial evidence only. Specific tagged test case(s): TestContainMappingUsesPixelEdgesAndExplicitLetterboxes. This does not establish the full requirement.

requirements.title: The compositor shall respect active pixels and hardware occlusion.
requirements.description: The compositor shall map app content only to declared active surfaces and exclude bezels, hinges and camera cutouts while preserving usable display around occlusions.

requirements.title: The compositor shall keep simulated chrome independent.
requirements.description: The presentation profile shall separate authentic app viewport, captured chrome, simulated status/home/menu/dock/browser layers and configurable backgrounds without doubling captured chrome or implying native device execution.

requirements.title: The compiler shall map source presentation timestamps.
requirements.description: The compiler shall retain source presentation timestamps including variable-frame-rate media and independently map trims, holds, speed and layout handoffs to output, motion and simulated clocks.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-SCREEN-CLOCKS protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.title: The compiler shall preserve source audio facts and default video output to silent.
requirements.description: When an imported recording contains audio, Device Studio shall default rendered video to silent, preserve the source bytes and inspected audio facts, and block unsupported passthrough with an actionable typed repair. It shall not generate narration or music as part of rendering.

validation.notes: P9 accepted the specified known-audible-marker protocol: unchanged source bytes and inspected facts, silent default output, typed blocked passthrough without a new job, and UI repair saved/read back. Exact evidence and retained BAS post-save selector failure and known Test Genie classifier failure are documented in docs/internal/goal/evidence/E2V/p8-matrix/audio/acceptance-review.md. This requirement completion is separate from full scenario release acceptance.

validation.notes: TestVideoAudioPolicyIsExplicitAndBlocksUnsupportedRender covers default/explicit silent policies, preserved unsupported passthrough, typed blocking issue, and unknown enum rejection. The scoped Test Genie run remains failed on the retained unit-health finding documented in the evidence review.
TestAudioInspectionProjectionDistinguishesLegacyZeroAndDetected verifies presence-aware persisted projection of detected audio facts versus legacy unknown facts.

TestInspectionReceiptV2DistinguishesZeroAndObservedAudio and TestInspectionAudioFactsPreserveOriginalIndexesAndRejectMalformedCodec cover native presence-aware facts, original stream indexes and malformed codec rejection.
